summary: Jefferies Credit Partners BDC Inc., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 3 to its credit agreement dated October 15, 2024, entered into October 9, 2026 with CIBC Bank USA as administrative agent and the lender group. The amendment extends the stated termination date to October 8, 2027 and reduces revolving commitments from $125 million to $100 million. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine credit-facility amendment covering items 1.01 and 2.03, not a special situation; no deal or arb angle applies.
